蘑菇領主解決了？不錯。酒館在傳，礦坑最近挖出了奇怪的聲音。: The Mushroom Lord's done? Not bad. Word at the tavern is the mine's been digging up strange noises.
礦坑巨像會重擊站在最前面的人。讓坦克頂住，治療盯好他。: The Mine Colossus smashes whoever stands in front. Let the tank take it and keep the healer on him.
礦工說巨像是自己醒的。這一帶的東西，好像都比以前躁動。: The miners say the colossus woke on its own. Everything around here seems more restless than it used to be.
潮汐祭司一直在叫魚人出來。範圍傷害夠不夠，打了就知道。: The Tide Priest keeps calling up fishfolk. You'll find out soon enough if your AoE is up to it.
海？這座島四周可是千年不散的霧。: The sea? This island has been wrapped in fog for a thousand years.
熔火督軍撐太久會狂暴。輸出不夠，就換人或換裝。: The Molten Warlord enrages if the fight drags. Short on damage? Swap heroes or gear.
你們的名字開始出現在酒館了。……懸賞榜最上面那張屠龍令，有人在問。: Your names are turning up at the tavern now. …Someone's been asking about that dragon-slaying writ at the top of the board.
巫妖會一邊放寒冰、一邊叫骷髏。治療和範圍都要夠。: The lich casts frost and raises skeletons at once. You'll need both healing and AoE.
龍……若是醒著……我們就不會……: If the dragon… were awake… we would never…
連死人都怕那條龍。: Even the dead fear that dragon.
虛空裂隙……這種東西本來不該出現在島上。: A void rift… something like this shouldn't exist on this island.
屠龍令還是沒人領。署名畫的是兩個彎月，公會裡沒人認得。: Still nobody's taken the dragon writ. It's signed with two crescent moons — no one at the guild recognizes it.
你們真的要去？……屠龍令的賞金，是公會開過最高的。: You're really going? …That writ carries the biggest bounty this guild has ever posted.
又一群拿著屠龍令的人……你們知道自己在做什麼嗎？: Another band holding that writ… do you even know what you're doing?
我以前有個同伴，守在對岸的燈塔。等這裡結束，我想去找她。: I once had a companion who kept the lighthouse across the sea. When this is over, I want to find her.
詛咒、護盾，血量一半後發狂——他會用上全部。這是最後一戰。: Curses, shields, and a frenzy past half health — he'll throw everything at you. This is the last fight.
島嶼篇完。——霧，開始散了。: End of the Island Saga. — The fog begins to lift.
裂谷闔上後第七天，一隻海鷗叼著封了總部火漆的信，飛進邊境公會。: Seven days after the rift closed, a gull flew into the frontier guild carrying a letter sealed in headquarters wax.
總部說，對岸維爾達的封印也在鬆動——他們點名要你去。: HQ says the seals across the sea in Verdane are loosening too — and they've asked for you by name.
低鳴聲不是從裂谷傳來的。是從海的那一頭。: The low hum isn't coming from the rift. It's coming from across the sea.
我有個同伴守在對岸的燈塔。她已經三個月沒有回信了。: A companion of mine keeps the lighthouse over there. She hasn't written back in three months.
千年不散的霧帆海，在你們開船那天退出了一條航線。: On the day you set sail, the thousand-year fog of the Mistsail Sea parted to open a single route.
三天後，鹽冠城的燈塔出現在海平線上——燈是暗的。: Three days later, the Saltcrown lighthouse rose over the horizon — dark.
你就是那個殺了龍又把裂谷關上的團長？歡迎來到維爾達。: So you're the leader who killed a dragon and then sealed the rift? Welcome to Verdane.
碼頭有人在走私封印石碎片。先從這個委託開始吧。: Someone's smuggling seal-stone shards through the docks. Start with that contract.
碼頭第三倉庫，晚上有船在卸貨，帳本上寫的是「鹽」。: Warehouse three on the docks. Ships unload there at night, and the ledger says "salt."
鹽不會發出低鳴。那是封印石。: Salt doesn't hum. Those are seal stones.
公會的狗也想分一杯羹？弟兄們，上船的上船，砍人的砍人！: The guild's dogs want a cut too? Lads — some of you board, the rest start swinging!
他的手下會一波波跳上岸。血量每掉一段就來一批，先清小的。: His crew will leap ashore in waves — a new batch each time his health drops a notch. Clear the small ones first.
我只是運貨的……錢是一個戴雙月面具的女人給的。: I just haul the cargo… The coin came from a woman in a twin-moon mask.
貨單上的下一站是鹽沼燈塔。歐林，那不是你朋友守的地方嗎？: The manifest's next stop is the Saltmarsh Lighthouse. Orin, isn't that where your friend keeps watch?
……潮水在唱歌。你聽不到嗎？它說門就快開了。: …The tide is singing. Can't you hear it? It says the gate will open soon.
她聽低鳴聽太久了。漲潮時坦克會被淹得很慘，治療要撐住；退潮再全力輸出。: She's listened to the hum for too long. At high tide the tank gets swamped — healers, hold on; go all-out when it ebbs.
歐林？……我守了三十年的燈，最後連燈都忘了點。: Orin? …Thirty years I kept that light, and in the end I forgot to light it.
守護者艾瓦拉睡在海淚之喉。教團的人拿著碎片，從沉鐘海窟繞過去了。: The guardian Aivara sleeps in the Seatear Throat. The cult took the shards around through the Sunken Bell Grotto.
燈塔重新亮了。這一次，換我們守住它。: The lighthouse is lit again. This time, we'll guard it.
沉鐘海窟最近失蹤了三艘船。倖存的水手說，是同伴先動的手。: Three ships have vanished near the Sunken Bell Grotto. Survivors say their own crewmates struck first.
來吧，讓我為你們唱一首……回不了家的歌。: Come, let me sing you a song… of never going home.
她讀條唱歌時一定要打斷，不然會有隊員轉頭打自己人。: Interrupt her whenever she starts singing, or one of your heroes will turn on the party.
這首歌……不是我的。是從海底深處傳來的，我只是跟著唱……: This song… isn't mine. It rises from the deep — I only sang along…
是「蝕」的歌。它已經醒到能讓海妖替它唱了。: It's the Eclipse's song. It's awake enough to make a siren sing for it.
雙月付的是金子，公會付得起什麼？你們的命？: The Twin Moons pay in gold. What can the guild pay? Your lives?
兩個一起上，跟雙子先知那次一樣——兩個坦克各扛一隻，血量一起壓。: Two at once, like the Twin Prophets — one tank on each, and bring their health down together.
好、好，我說！真正的雇主不是教團……是白隼王國的騎士長，艾德溫。: All right, all right, I'll talk! Our real employer isn't the cult… it's a knight-captain of the Whitefalcon Kingdom. Edwin.
王國的騎士？……這下麻煩了。: A knight of the kingdom? …This just got complicated.
我是白隼騎士團的洛恩。艾德溫是我的上司——曾經是。: I'm Lorne of the Whitefalcon Knights. Edwin was my commander — once.
王國已經爛了，國王只會看著封印碎掉。蝕給了我重來的力量。: The kingdom is rotten; the king will just watch the seals crumble. The Eclipse gave me the power to start over.
他有護盾，血量一半會發狂，拖太久還會狂暴。號角和爆發留到後半段。: He shields, frenzies at half health, and enrages if it drags on. Save the horn and your burst for the second half.
你們以為……只有我一個人嗎……: You think… I'm the only one…
騎士團欠你們一次，我跟你們走。等前哨整頓好，我把騎士團的潮汐陣法教給你們。: The order owes you one, and I'm coming with you. Once the outpost is in order, I'll teach you the knights' Tide Formation.
日之先知、月之先知是我的老師。你們在龍眠島打敗了他們？: The Prophets of the Sun and Moon were my teachers. You defeated them on Dragonrest?
沒關係。老師沒做完的，我來做完——艾瓦拉已經快聽不見自己的心跳了。: No matter. I'll finish what they began — Aivara can barely hear her own heartbeat now.
漲潮、讀條、召喚都會來。打斷留給讀條，範圍留給小怪。: Tides, casts and summons — all of it. Save interrupts for casts and AoE for the adds.
太遲了……主人已經在聽了。: Too late… the master is already listening.
祭壇下的海水，開始逆著潮汐往外退。: Beneath the altar, the sea began to pull away against the tide.
艾瓦拉守著這片海一千年。她不是怪物——至少以前不是。: Aivara has guarded this sea for a thousand years. She isn't a monster — at least, she wasn't.
（悠長的鯨鳴，聽不出是哭泣還是怒吼。）: (A long whale call — impossible to tell whether it is weeping or rage.)
別殺她。打到她倒下，我和瑪蕾來淨化。她會漲潮、會魅惑，血量一半之後會更兇。: Don't kill her. Bring her down, and Marei and I will purify her. She'll raise the tide and charm you, and she gets fiercer past half health.
艾瓦拉倒下的瞬間，歐林和瑪蕾一起把封印石按進海床。: The moment Aivara fell, Orin and Marei pressed the seal stone into the seabed together.
黑霧從她身上退開，鯨鳴變回了很久以前的調子。: The black mist drained away from her, and her song returned to a melody from long ago.
……小小的團長。你們島上的龍，是我的兄弟。: …Little leader. The dragon on your island was my brother.
謝謝你們，這次沒有殺我。: Thank you for not killing me this time.
騎士團會守住海岸。王都那邊，我得回去把艾德溫的事說清楚。: The knights will hold the coast. As for the capital — I have to go back and answer for Edwin.
總部剛收到消息——灰燼高原的火山噴發了，風語部族在求援。: Word just reached HQ — the volcano in the Ashen Highlands has erupted, and the Windspeaker tribes are calling for help.
你們聽到了嗎？那不是低鳴。是有人在說話。: Did you hear that? That wasn't a hum. Someone was speaking.
